text: GTA 6 is packed with details, but I think my favorite one is that if you are swimming far off shore
And you're stranded you will hear a faint bark
You see the developers didn't want you getting stranded out in the ocean and having to swim back to shore for 10 minutes
If your boat sinks or something like that
So when you hear the faint barking you look around and you will see this guy
He's called cool dog. He wears little sunglasses and drives a jet ski
You climb aboard and he will drive you back to shore while blasting some tunes
However, if you don't get off of the jet ski
He will continue to take you all the way to a little island where he lives with all of the other dog friends
Once you get there
He will go around the island and dig up on the shore different items like a wallet that has like
$1,200 in it which is super valuable early in the game
And then other things like toys where he wants you to like pick up the football and throw it for him and his buddies to chase down
Like I know it sounds like I'm making this up
But I am not if you are stranded in the ocean a cool dog with sunglasses will come and rescue you on a jet ski
And then bring you home where he gives you tons of treats and toys to play with
This game is insane man. Also real quick guys Landon who is the editor
Extraordinaire that makes all of this possible on this page. He gets a bonus at the end of the year based on total follower counts
So if you are not following
Follow because he gets a bigger paycheck at the end of the year and it takes money out of my pocket and puts it in his
